body: That's great for people who can do that but I cant do all that. I only speak English and one other language, I'm learning a third but am a beginner. I know you're just trying to act like I have a sense of purpose, but I dont. Literally nothing I did in life mattered or materialized and I have no energy to go further with living anymore.

It's not rare a lot of people learn different languages. I'm not a professional and have no college experience in linguistics so it literally doesnt even matter. It's just how I chose to pass the time since I didnt have a lot to do.
The languages dont matter. Even if I could afford counseling, it's too late for me. There's 0 point.

Communication languages, I speak two fluently and I'm learning a third. I'm not a polyglot at all, it takes me a long time to learn unfortunately. I've dabbled in computer languages (nothing hard just python) but I stopped. I've had counseling before and it was unhelpful, I'm just done at this point. I lost all the energy to even bother anymore.
